label: Isostasy and flexure
text: EA.O.A2.4 Isostasy and flexure. The lithosphere is in buoyant equilibrium on the asthenosphere. Airy compensation uses crustal roots; Pratt compensation uses lateral density change. Many ranges are partly supported by flexure of an elastic plate. Glacial isostatic adjustment is the observable rebound after ice load.
